reasoning: On the season so far the Nuggets are the stronger team; with home court the Nuggets start about 8 points better, in a game of about 233 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Nuggets.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Nuggets win 76 times in 100, by about 9; most games like this end between 206 and 254 total points.

analyst.text: Dallas are on a back-to-back after nearly blowing a 16-point lead to Utah, with Cooper Flagg admitting the team 'got complacent'; P.J. Washington (illness) has missed two games.
